cohort: Singleton live births in Japan from the Japan Environment and Children's Study (JECS) born between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation.
finding: Early-term birth (37 to 38 weeks gestation) was associated with an increased risk of respiratory distress in neonates born by cesarean delivery without indication for early delivery.
mod_finding: Neonates born by elective cesarean delivery at early term had a higher risk of respiratory distress compared to those born at full term.
